summary_5_lines.business: Handi House Restaurant Jhelum — a desi handi/karahi restaurant on GT Road, Jada, Jhelum 49600; 4.1 stars from 800+ Google reviews; phone +92 313 544 4333.
summary_5_lines.design_direction: Asymmetric photo collage in ink navy, warm cream, muted brass and sage, with Instrument Serif display type and Inter Tight body — a headline column overlapping a three-photo collage of karahi, copper handi and night flames.
summary_5_lines.signature_elements: Rotated cream-framed collage tiles, a three-chapter menu board, a dark navy spice feature band, a family-nights grill spread, and a lightbox gallery.
summary_5_lines.what_could_not_be_verified: Opening hours, official menu and prices, signature dishes, takeaway/delivery, family seating and parking — none published in sources found; no verbatim reviews retrievable, so no quotes are used.
summary_5_lines.why_chosen: RESERVE build: the primary, Royal Courtyard Cafe&Restaurant, was rejected because trek.pk lists an own-domain website (royalcourtyard.pk) for it. Handi House has no website button on trek.pk and no own website in search results.

evidence: trek.pk Jhelum restaurants page (fetched 2026-11-21 08:16 UTC): Royal Courtyard entry shows Call, WhatsApp, Website (royalcourtyard.pk), Map; 4.5 stars (585 reviews); +92 336 644 4786

royalcourtyard.pk DNS resolves (198.18.121.35 via VM resolver) but HTTPS returns an empty reply from this VM and browser.open reports it unresolvable as a public page — the site itself could not be loaded, but the own-domain listing is the disqualifier under the task rule
Web search for royalcourtyard.pk returned no live site in results, but the trek.pk Website button is sufficient evidence of an own domain

Reserve check: trek.pk Handi House entry shows only Call, WhatsApp, Map — NO Website button; web search 'Handi House Jhelum restaurant GT Road website' returned no own website, only directory listings
swap.primary_business: Royal Courtyard Cafe&Restaurant, GT Road, Kala Gujran, Jhelum 49600
swap.reason: trek.pk lists a 'Website' button for Royal Courtyard Cafe&Restaurant linking to royalcourtyard.pk — an own domain named after the business. Per the task rule, a business with its own domain must not be built.

collision_fix.cause: Original builder checked collisions by comparing bare integer IDs against 'pexels:'-prefixed design-log strings, so 14 reused IDs were missed. Fixed with a stem-normalised check: stem(i) = strip 'pexels:' prefix and non-digits, so 'pexels:28674556', '28674556' and 'photo-28674556-...' all become 'pexels:28674556'.
collision_fix.verification: Every replacement ID stem-checked against (a) design-log.json all 51 entries / 1073 IDs, (b) Site A Spice Orchid 22 IDs, (c) Site B Platter House current 25 IDs, (d) the 8 kept IDs — 0 hits in all four sets. Final 22 IDs re-checked the same way: 0 external collisions (the 8 keeps match only themselves).
